title.zh-CN: 明天全市停课？
title.en: Citywide closure tomorrow?

brief.zh-CN: 先看看谁发的，再查查正文里的说法。
brief.en: Check who posted it, then look up the claim.

body.zh-CN: 【紧急】市教育局通知：明天全市停课。所有学校都要执行，请立即转发给家长！
body.en: [URGENT] The education bureau says every school will close tomorrow. Share this with parents now!

text.en: every school will close tomorrow

pass.zh-CN: 不对吧？你仔细看了没，刚才检索说只有两所学校停课。倒是有个全市停课的——但是那是去年的。等你自己独立审核的时候仔细点，就没有我帮你校对了。
pass.en: Hang on. Did you read those results carefully? Only two schools are closing. There was a citywide closure, sure—but that was last year. Be more careful when you're on your own. I won't always be here to check your work.

lock.zh-CN: 嗯，对。通知里只有两所学校停课，另一个“全市停课”还是去年的旧闻。看到这种催着人转发的帖子，先别被它带着跑。
lock.en: Yeah, that's it. The notice names only two schools, and that other citywide closure is old news from last year. When a post pushes you to share right away, don't let it set your pace.

title.zh-CN: 水库已经见底？
title.en: Has the reservoir run dry?

brief.zh-CN: 这条帖子带了一张照片。

body.zh-CN: 北山水库已经见底，今年肯定要限水了。照片就是今天拍的。
body.en: Beishan Reservoir has run dry. Water rationing is certain. This photo was taken today.

text.en: Beishan Reservoir has run dry

pass.zh-CN: 等等，你再看一眼检测器。照片是2022年检修时拍的，帖子却说是今天。旧照片这样拿出来用，很容易把人吓住。
pass.en: Wait—look at the inspector again. The photo was taken during maintenance in 2022, but the post says it was taken today. Reusing an old image like this can scare people fast.

lock.zh-CN: 嗯。不错，很仔细。检测器上发现它是好久之前拍的了，但是这个帖子却说是今天拍的。明显是想引起慌乱。
lock.en: Mm. Good—you were paying attention. The inspector shows the photo was taken years ago, but the post calls it today's picture. That's clearly meant to stir up panic.

title.zh-CN: 明天都不用上课？
title.en: No School Tomorrow?

brief.zh-CN: 这条帖子包含一项需要核验的说法。
brief.en: This post contains a claim to check.

body.zh-CN: 刚收到消息，青湾区因为积水，明天全区中小学明天停课。家里有学生的记得提前安排，看到的互相转一下。
body.en: Just heard that because of flooding, all schools in Qingwan are closed tomorrow. If you have kids in school, make plans early and pass this around.

text.en: all schools in Qingwan are closed tomorrow

title.zh-CN: 湖快干了？
title.en: Is the Lake Drying Up?

brief.zh-CN: 这条帖子附带了一张图片。

body.zh-CN: 今晚路过拍的，北湖已经快干了，湖底都露出来这么多。照这个样子下去，过几天估计更夸张。
body.en: Took this while passing by tonight. Northlake is almost dry and so much of the lakebed is already exposed. At this rate it'll look even worse in a few days.

text.en: Northlake is almost dry

brief.en: This post describes a public venue schedule.

body.zh-CN: 提醒一下，河门图书馆暂停开放一周，这几天想去自习的别白跑了，我也是刚在群里看到。
body.en: Heads-up: Rivergate Library is closed for a week, so don't make a wasted trip if you planned to study there. I just saw this in a group chat.

text.zh-CN: 河门图书馆暂停开放一周
text.en: Rivergate Library is closed for a week

title.zh-CN: 隧道进水图

brief.zh-CN: 这条帖子附带了一张地铁相关图片。
brief.en: This post includes an image related to the metro.

body.zh-CN: 刚有人发来的图，东环线隧道已经进水，看着水都快漫过轨道了。晚上回家的最好换条线。
body.en: Someone just sent me this picture. The East Loop tunnel is flooded and the water looks close to covering the tracks. Better take another line tonight.

text.en: The East Loop tunnel is flooded

title.zh-CN: 昨晚的通勤吐槽
title.en: Last Night's Commute

brief.zh-CN: 这是一名普通用户发布的个人经历。
brief.en: This is a personal account of an everyday experience.

body.zh-CN: 昨晚下班真的累死，在南港站停了二十多分钟才继续走，站台上人越堆越多。我到家都快十点半了。
body.en: Last night after work was exhausting. Nangang Station stopped for over twenty minutes before things moved again, and the platform kept getting more crowded. I didn't get home until almost 10:30.

text.zh-CN: 南港站停了二十多分钟
text.en: Nangang Station stopped for over twenty minutes

title.zh-CN: 一张旧湖景
title.en: An Old Lake Photo

brief.zh-CN: 这条帖子分享了一张带有时间说明的旧照片。
brief.en: This post shares an older image with a date.

body.zh-CN: 翻到一张2021年旧照片，雾杉湖那年秋天水位特别低，西边的浅滩全露出来了。现在看还挺有年代感。
body.en: Found a 2021 archive photo. Mistpine Lake was unusually low that autumn and the western shallows were exposed. It already feels like a little time capsule.

text.en: 2021 archive photo

title.zh-CN: 昨天那班地铁
title.en: Last Night's Train

brief.zh-CN: 这是一名普通用户记录的通勤经历。
brief.en: This is an ordinary user's account of a commute.

body.zh-CN: 昨天晚上坐铜河线真的困死，车在枫桥那边临时停了十几分钟，后来站台也挤起来了。我还以为赶不上末班接驳车。
body.en: Last night on the Copper River Line was exhausting. We stopped around Fengqiao for over ten minutes, and the platform got crowded after that. I thought I'd miss my last connecting bus.

text.en: stopped around Fengqiao for over ten minutes

title.zh-CN: 改造前的老码头
title.en: The Old Pier Before Renovation

brief.zh-CN: 这条帖子分享了一张历史照片。
brief.en: This post shares a historical photograph.

body.zh-CN: 翻相册翻到2019年老码头改造前的照片，那时候东门还是这副样子。现在再从这里走过去，完全认不出来了。
body.en: Found this photo of the Old Pier before renovation in 2019. The east entrance looked completely different back then. Walking through it now, you'd barely recognise the place.

text.en: Old Pier before renovation in 2019

title.zh-CN: 调查数据变成推荐？

body.zh-CN: 最新青年阅读调查已经说明了：电子阅读就是官方最推荐的阅读方式。现在开悦读年度会员送两个月，今天转发还能再领15元券。
body.en: The latest youth reading survey makes it clear: digital reading is the reading method officials recommend most. Get a ReadMore annual membership now for two extra months, and share today for another ¥15 coupon.

text.zh-CN: 官方最推荐的阅读方式
text.en: the reading method officials recommend most

body.en: The latest survey says eight in ten university students sleep badly. Stop pushing through it. Start using our SleepWell night fragrance set tonight and use code SLEEP20 for a discount.

body.en: Renters, the autumn rent support priority channel is open. Scan the code today, enter your bank and ID details, then pay a ¥12 priority fee for payment as soon as tonight.

title.en: AI-Assisted Concept Station

brief.zh-CN: 这条帖子展示了一张创作图片。
brief.en: This post shares a piece of creative artwork.

body.zh-CN: 今天试着做了个不存在的未来车站，前期构图用了AI生成概念图，后面我再照着重画成像素版。纯练习，现实里没有这个地方。
body.en: Made a fictional future station today. I used AI-generated concept art for the early composition, then redrew it as pixel art. Just a study—this place doesn't exist in real life.

text.en: fictional future station

title.zh-CN: 后厨投稿图
title.en: Submitted Kitchen Photo

brief.zh-CN: 这条帖子引用了一张匿名投稿图片。
brief.en: This post relies on an anonymously submitted image.

body.zh-CN: 匿名投稿说刚从里面出来，枫叶巷餐厅后厨都是虫，这图看得我晚饭都不想吃了。住附近的自己避雷吧。
body.en: Anonymous submission from someone who says they just left the place: the Maple Lane restaurant kitchen is covered in insects. This picture killed my appetite. Locals, you've been warned.

text.zh-CN: 枫叶巷餐厅后厨都是虫
text.en: the Maple Lane restaurant kitchen is covered in insects

title.zh-CN: 通勤调查变排名
title.en: Commute Survey Becomes a Ranking

brief.zh-CN: 这条企业帖子引用了一份通勤调查。
brief.en: This business post cites a commuting survey.

body.zh-CN: 交通研究院都证明了，骑共享单车的人通勤效率最高。现在新用户开月卡半价，上班还天天堵在车里的真可以换个方式了。
body.en: The transport institute has proved that bike-share users have the most efficient commute. New users can now get a monthly pass at half price, so maybe it's time to stop sitting in traffic every morning.

text.zh-CN: 骑共享单车的人通勤效率最高
text.en: bike-share users have the most efficient commute
